INCLUDED THROUGH OTHER PRS / ALREADY ABSORBED
- #408 ports #174 (K8 HMMA unroll), #250 (page filters), #288 (whole-copy upload
  skip), #319 (optional OoT no-sharpen network bypass), and Eglantine #634/#639.
  They are not merged a second time as independent changes.
- #387 includes #253's optional NVIDIA DLSS/DLAA implementation in its ancestry.
  #387 adds runtime toggle, sharpness and resolution-scaled DLAA controls.
- #206's merge changes no tree files: the upstream baseline already contains the
  same CAS-loop behavior. Its source history is retained, not applied twice.
- #204 is already addressed by upstream #215; #345 adapts the same query-flush
  mechanism to its precise split-front read tracking.
- Latest upstream nx2 includes the previously integrated #121/#127 and the
  newer #184/#194/#215/#240/#284/#295/#397/#398/#410/#412/#413/#414/#232 landings.
- Historical fix/oot-boot, fix/oot-bloom, fix/oot-upscaler-gathers,
  feat/oot-builtin-maxres, capy/fix-oot-amd-ssbo-alignment-sync,
  capy/oot-paired-cbuf-loaded-pointer and port/ducky-oot-nx2 branches have
  production equivalents in nx2. perf/oot-* chains are pre-#184 checkpoints;
  their validated production paths are already absorbed by upstream.

MERGE RESOLUTION / INTEGRATION FOLLOW-UPS
- #353 + #408: keep both the dynamic fragment color component mask and
  OotNetwork bypass state in RasterizerVulkan.
- #354 + #245: handle-table descriptor arrays retain host-aligned storage bases
  on Vulkan and OpenGL. The evaluator takes element and storage_alignment;
  batching and single-handle evaluation use the same aligned base. Existing
  alignment tests are retained and an array+alignment regression section added.
- #415 + #354: preserve indirect_offset and write_extent through descriptor
  joining/remapping and both compute pipeline backends.
- #300 + #395: retain deferred AMD HMMA compilation and null-pointer-slot
  pipeline rebuilding together.
- #143 + #387 + #408: retain all three independent interfaces (Intel tensor
  stand-in, optional NVIDIA DLSS/DLAA, optional no-sharpen network bypass).
  DLSS and No sharpening remain opt-in; Game remains the bypass default.
- #345 is the reviewed cc808c195f version: learned acquires removed, opaque
  writes/aliases tracked, High accuracy kept out of the release shortcut,
  report writes tracked globally, query wait bounded with shared callback state.
  Preserve #178's instance-loop state and #397's pending CPU-write enumeration.
- 8e3a873f1a: semantic merge repair only. Auto-merge created duplicate
  OnCacheInvalidations methods because u64/size_t spellings hid their equivalence.
  Keep one method, ClaimCpuWrites first (#397 correctness), then batch cache
  locks and pipeline invalidations (#345). No new game-specific algorithm.
- 90856c3014: the storage-binding test mock gains GetMaxStorageBufferRange for
  #351 and expects the full mapped 80 MiB read-only pool instead of obsolete
  64 MiB cap. This prevents a test-template compile failure and stale assertions.

SKIPPED / ALTERNATIVES
- #161/#166: old broad timing/performance packages with substantial overlap and
  opt-in experiment plumbing; prefer current upstream plus focused production PRs.
- #179 and #411: drafts / work in progress; not ready to merge.
- #231: depends on #179's draft semaphore fast-path and includes its ancestry.
  #345 provides reviewed independent split-front handling instead.
- #216: alternative real-time hook patches the same game instruction as already
  bundled #240 Dynamic FPS; keep #240 and apply #299's 10-fps clamp adjustment.
- #223: 142-file historical AMD/performance/debug package; many pieces already
  merged and its author explicitly lists experiment switches not for nx2.
  Focused AMD HMMA #300 is included instead.
- #235: opt-in High-accuracy split path; #408 reports fog/occlusion regressions
  when testing it. Not needed for current production default.
- #243: alternative precise DMA-read implementation, overlaps #345's front
  write/report tracking. Do not stack competing implementations.
- #259: experimental preflush switch with acknowledged visual flicker.
- #267: mixed historical 60-fps integration package; overlaps #243/#311/query
  handling and changes SSBO capacity to 64 while #354 uses 32-bit binding masks.
  Exact current tip lacks matched gameplay validation. Do not merge wholesale.
- #292: alternative 256-MiB compute-only read-only-pool cap; choose newer #351's
  mapping/host-range policy rather than overlay two policies for the same issue.
- #313: alternative pipeline eviction budget; #408 provides the tested combined
  key/budget/DontInline path with a more conservative 1/16-RAM budget.
- #278: optional filesystem throttle experiment; default behavior unchanged,
  limited validation. Focused #251 movie/audio clock fix included instead.
- #301/#309/#377/#182/#186: diagnostics / sampling / logging-only changes are
  outside this gameplay integration scope.
- #282/#318: closed predecessors of #319, which is ported by #408.
- bisect/oot-*, exp/oot-*, test/oot-*, port/ducky-oot-build16, fix/oot-fog and
  perf/oot-* historical branches contain bisection points, visual workarounds,
  diagnostics or earlier candidates. No historical branch is merged wholesale.
